viewing_check: Estimate 20-40, current bid $10. 22% premium. Terapeak (3 years) shows Sanro trench coats selling about $15-55 each (median roughly $30) and St Michael trenches $24-47, so two coats together are worth roughly $40-70 at best on eBay before postage and listing effort. Check condition, size (Sanro is size 10) and any marks. Prices look flat, mostly 2024-2026.
